Minister highlights central aid to Himachal, BJP's UCC stance

Union Minister Anurag Thakur stated that Himachal Pradesh has received unprecedented central support over the past decade. He also affirmed the BJP's commitment to implementing a Uniform Civil Code nationwide. These statements were made in separate contexts, with the former emphasizing developmental assistance to the state and the latter addressing a key party policy.
